name: MUFFLE FURNACE
desc: Premium Heavy-Duty Laboratory Muffle Furnace designed for high-temperature thermal processing, ashing, and material testing up to 1200°C. Features a 13-liter internal capacity, built with high-grade Kanthal A1 heating elements and a highly responsive R-Type thermocouple.
features: Premium Grade Kanthal A1 High-Temperature Resistance Wires
Heavy-Duty R-Type Thermocouple for accurate thermal tracking
Advanced Microprocessor-Based PID Digital Controller Layout
Double-walled structure with high-grade ceramic fiberboard insulation
